NOVELTY.assessment: Reduction after augmenting the loss automaton still open.

VALUE.assessment: Budgets enter control tightenings; no demonstrated control-side gain here.

FEASIBILITY.assessment: Linear bounded-noise conditioning is tractable on short paths; single-axis probe supplies local evidence.

TRACTABILITY.assessment: Uniform boundary memory closure for this delayed system is unproven.

TESTABILITY.assessment: Attainable lower/upper bounds provide falsifiable tests.

ETHICAL_COST.assessment: Evaluation restricted to synthetic bounded-state models; no flight or human data.

fatal_flaws.description: Whether standard exact augmentation plus the recurrent observer directly implies the remaining theory.

decision.rationale: One fixed event word has a sharp worst-case scalar information advantage over discarding, not a uniform all-word algorithmic gain. Need adversarial full-language certificate, equal-information baseline and independent review.
